driftFindings.finding: Older onboarding docs still describe coordination-only/no-scripts architecture despite later locked operational-intelligence ownership and 282 script files / 104 npm scripts.
driftFindings.fix: Separate governance/documentation reconciliation mission; do not weaken the product-implementation placement rule.

driftFindings.finding: Files named CURRENT have different freshness dates; ACTIVE_WORK (2026-09-04) is newer than CURRENT_HANDOFF (2026-08-25) and CURRENT_GATES (unresolved 2026-08-02 issue).
driftFindings.fix: Add sourceCommitSha / freshThrough metadata plus a deterministic stale-current-doc check.

driftFindings.finding: m8-github-plane-mandatory.mdc forbids ad-hoc git add/commit/push outside a compiled planHash, but scripts/harvest/harvest-closeout-git.mjs (git checkout -b/add/commit) and scripts/harvest/chatgpt-publish-draft.mjs (git push origin chat-gpt-harvest) do exactly that via execSync. Both default to dry-run. The rule concedes HARD_ENFORCEMENT is NOT_STARTED.
driftFindings.fix: Explicit disposition: exempt these scripts in the rule, or route them through the M8 plane. Do not leave the contradiction undocumented.

driftFindings.finding: 41 test scripts exist; the architecture matrix runs 16; hosted CI enforces 2. Nine of thirteen intelligence suites are outside the matrix entirely.
driftFindings.fix: Decide whether the matrix (or a dependency-aware subset) becomes a required CI gate, and whether the nine intelligence suites belong in the matrix.

driftFindings.finding: docs/HARDENING.md explicitly records NOT_YET_VERIFIED at an older commit; it is not current health proof.
driftFindings.fix: Run a fresh hardening mission bound to the current SHA before making health claims.

driftFindings.finding: harvest/README.md says do not hand-edit mirrored protocol files and to edit docs/ sources instead, but harvest/protocol/chat-thread-closeout-autopsy-harvest-v1.md is v1.3/1031 lines while its declared source docs/runbooks/chat-thread-closeout-autopsy-harvest-v1.md is v1/599 lines. The mirror carries the mandatory HARVEST_GIT_DURABILITY_RULE the source lacks. Same inversion for the ChatGPT protocol (v2.1 mirror vs v2 source). Five harvest/protocol files have no docs/ counterpart at all.
driftFindings.interimRule: Treat harvest/protocol/ as authoritative and docs/ as stale until the sync direction is repaired.
driftFindings.fix: Repair the sync direction or redesignate the source of truth.

driftFindings.finding: index/cg-federated-repo-index.v1.json declares capabilities, protocols, surfaces, dependencies, PROGRAMS, WORK_PACKAGES, SYMBOL_POINTERS, LATEST_RECEIPTS, DECISIONS, BLOCKERS and SUPERSEDED_ITEMS as empty arrays with a single CODE_POINTERS entry. It also carries schema cg-federated-repo-index-v1@1.0.0 alongside schemaVersion cg-federated-repo-index-v2.
driftFindings.risk: The estate router learns almost nothing about this repo while AI_INDEX.md holds the real map - two indexes, one populated, one authoritative to the router.
driftFindings.fix: Decide the relationship explicitly before rolling the deep-index pattern to further repos, or the estate forks into two incompatible index formats.

driftFindings.finding: index/cg-federated-repo-index.v1.json has INDEX_GENERATED_AT of 2000-02-08T16:42:02.562Z (year 2000). The companion estate-100 receipt records publishedAt 2026-09-03T23:42:02.956Z; near-identical sub-second components indicate a clock/serialization defect at generation, not a placeholder. LAST_INDEXED_SHA 69582666 is real and recent.
driftFindings.risk: Any freshness comparison against INDEX_GENERATED_AT computes a ~26-year-old index and will always-refresh or always-fail a staleness gate.
driftFindings.fix: Repair in the generator (owned by AppBuilder), not by hand-editing the generated file.

driftFindings.finding: correlation-markers-v1.schema.json permits markerBudget.max in 1..64; validateCorrelationBlock() hard-fails unless it is exactly 48 (MARKER_BUDGET_MAX).
driftFindings.risk: A producer writing to the published schema can emit a schema-valid handoff that ingest rejects with CORRELATION_MARKERS_INVALID.
driftFindings.fix: Tighten the schema to const 48, or relax the validator to the schema range. Until then producers must emit exactly 48.

driftFindings.finding: The correct WSL root is /home/wesley/repos. The typo /home/wesle/repos (missing y) appears 277 times across 75 files, including live code (scripts/runner/lib/wesleydesk-host.mjs:61), a test env default (run-hot-cache-dataset-registry-authority.test.mjs:82), a test fixture, two orphaned generators, a live estate publication receipt (work-progress/publications/cg-federated-repo-index-estate-100-v1/cross-agent-publication-receipt.json), and foundational docs (AGENT_START_HERE.md, decisions/DECISION_LOG.md, handoffs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.md). The remainder are historical artifacts/**.
driftFindings.existingGuard: run-hot-cache-dataset-registry-authority.test.mjs:60 already asserts the typo is absent - but only for one dataset file.
driftFindings.fix: Correct live code, test defaults, receipts and foundational docs; leave immutable artifacts/** evidence alone; generalize the existing assertion into a repo-wide check.

driftFindings.finding: work-progress/publications/cg-federated-repo-index-estate-100-v1/cross-agent-publication-receipt.json records sourceShas.estateContentSha256 as null while capabilityContentSha256 is populated.
driftFindings.risk: A publication receipt with a null source hash cannot support the SHA-alignment verification the publication chain depends on.

driftFindings.finding: IDEMPOTENT_REINGEST_PASS and LOCAL_RUNTIME_VALIDATED are hardcoded null in every ingest receipt. The id scheme makes idempotency structurally likely but it is asserted nowhere.
driftFindings.fix: Implement the re-ingest comparison and set the key, or document it as permanently caller-supplied. Do not let null be read as true.

driftFindings.finding: scripts/runner/ contains concrete WESLEYDESK bootstrap/network scripts while the CI runner label on main is ryzen9desk and machine authority has evolved elsewhere.
driftFindings.fix: Index them as support adapters and require current machine-registry resolution before mutation.

mechanicalVerificationRecipe.purpose: Run before the narrative pass when indexing any repo in this estate. Findings F,G,H,I,J,K in AI_INDEX.md all came from this pass.
checks: scale: git ls-files | wc -l, then per-directory counts to decide what NOT to scan
path typos and forbidden host roots (git grep for /home/wesle/repos, C:\Developer\repos, /mnt/c/Developer)
orphaned scripts: present in scripts/ but referenced by no npm script, workflow, or importer
generated mirrors drifted ahead of declared source: compare version line and line count for every doc pair
contract vs implementation constants: schema minimum/maximum/const vs code _MAX/_MIN
corrupt or impossible timestamps in generated artifacts
null hashes in receipts that gate SHA alignment
mechanicalVerificationRecipe.ordering: Mechanical pass first, then narrative. The narrative pass resolves what the repo means; the mechanical pass finds what it gets wrong.
